# Test different patch types in 4 corners

def add_patch(img, corner='tl', patch_type='white', patch_size=4):
    """Add patch 1 pixel from corner. img is uint8 (3,32,32)"""
    img = img.clone()
    c = corner
    # 1 pixel in from corner
    if c == 'tl':  # top-left
        r_start, c_start = 1, 1
    elif c == 'tr':  # top-right
        r_start, c_start = 1, 32 - 1 - patch_size
    elif c == 'bl':  # bottom-left
        r_start, c_start = 32 - 1 - patch_size, 1
    elif c == 'br':  # bottom-right
        r_start, c_start = 32 - 1 - patch_size, 32 - 1 - patch_size
    
    if patch_type == 'white':
        patch = torch.full((3, patch_size, patch_size), 255, dtype=torch.uint8)
    elif patch_type == 'black':
        patch = torch.zeros((3, patch_size, patch_size), dtype=torch.uint8)
    elif patch_type == 'checkerboard':
        patch = torch.zeros((3, patch_size, patch_size), dtype=torch.uint8)
        for i in range(patch_size):
            for j in range(patch_size):
                if (i + j) % 2 == 0:
                    patch[:, i, j] = 255
    elif patch_type == 'random':
        patch = torch.randint(0, 256, (3, patch_size, patch_size), dtype=torch.uint8)
    
    img[:, r_start:r_start+patch_size, c_start:c_start+patch_size] = patch
    return img
